R1_01_approval_intent_singleton.mechanism: deterministic intent_id, idempotency_key, and client_order_id derived via sha256 from immutable case_hash:proposal_hash:approval_event_id; approval_event_id stored as UNIQUE natural authority in live_trade_intents; replay under identical approval returns existing authority; divergent payload under same approval fails closed with ExecutionBlocked

R1_02_credential_authority.mechanism: structural CredentialAuthority metadata bound on BinanceSignedClient (.authority) carrying environment, credential_namespace, and rest_base_url; ExecutionCapabilityPolicyV1 validates actual client authority before mutation; TESTNET factory reads only BINANCE_TESTNET_* variables without consuming LIVE env vars; AccountWatch validates signed_client.authority in TESTNET mode

R1_03_preexec_revalidation.mechanism: PreExecutionValidator verifies active proposal on case, approval record actor and recomputed content_hash, distinguishes compile snapshot vs fresh reconciled current snapshot, recalculates RiskPolicy authority & risk limits (daily loss, drawdown, symbol/portfolio exposure, available margin, position counts, open orders), checks Tactical validity provider (fails closed with TACTICAL_VALIDITY_UNAVAILABLE if missing in TESTNET), and prevents local duplicate client_order_id

R1_04_delayed_fill_protection.mechanism: reconcile_intent and submit_intent query exchange open protective orders; if filled_qty > 0 and no protection exists, places protective stop for filled_qty; if existing protection < filled_qty, cancels smaller order and places resized order for full filled_qty; exchange query uncertainty trips KillSwitch and fails closed; protection quantity never exceeds position quantity

R1_05_supervisor_orchestration.mechanism: real execution coordinator (LiveExecutionService.execute_approved_intent and reconcile_intent) orchestrates post-fill PositionObservationV1 directly into PositionSupervisor.process; converts material PositionEvent to PositionCase and delivers to AnalysisService; durable live_position_case_dispatches prevents duplicate analysis across restarts; source-bound market/Tactical inputs are explicitly nullable without neutral masquerade

R1_06_short_position_open.mechanism: PositionSupervisor.evaluate triggers POSITION_OPENED on previous_quantity == 0.0 and quantity != 0.0; supports both long (quantity > 0) and short (quantity < 0) positions with durable open-state tracking and deduplication

R1_1_01_durable_position_case_recovery.mechanism: PositionSupervisor persists PositionEvent and outbox record in live_position_case_dispatches with explicit PENDING/DISPATCHING/DONE/FAILED_CLOSED lifecycle in single atomic transaction; atomic lease claiming with lease_expires_at_ms ensures safe restart recovery without requiring original observation replay; position_case_from_event derives deterministic CasePackageV1 identity strictly from immutable event.observed_at_ms; downstream LiveStore case reservation prevents repeated primary-provider LLM analysis across retries; DONE never dispatches twice

R1_1_02_protection_uses_current_open_pos.mechanism: protective reconciliation queries authoritative current position risk from exchange (handling One-Way and Hedge modes); target protection quantity is strictly min(current open position, relevant entry fill, intent.quantity) and never exceeds actual open position; if open position is flat (<= 0.0), cancels stale protection without placing new order; position query failure or unsupported mode trips KillSwitch and fails closed; DryRun backend supports open_position_provider

R1_1_03_signed_client_isolated_testnet_a.mechanism: BinanceSignedClient constructor defaults environment='UNBOUND' and credential_namespace='UNBOUND', which fails closed under ExecutionCapabilityPolicyV1; create_testnet_signed_client factory requires valid BINANCE_TESTNET_API_KEY and BINANCE_TESTNET_API_SECRET, never reads LIVE credentials, and fails startup closed on missing credentials

R1_2_01_frozen_position_case_outbox.mechanism: PositionSupervisor persists exact PositionCase authority (position_case_id, position_case_hash, position_case_json, case_hash) into live_position_case_dispatches before external side effects; retry reuses exact stored case without re-querying fresh_market_case; tampered hash/JSON or event-linkage mismatch fails closed; additive migration maintains backward compatibility

R2_01_proposal_intent_compilation_bindin.mechanism: Shared compile_executable_intent_fields derives canonical executable fields (symbol, side, order_type, price, quantity, leverage, stop_loss, take_profit_1, take_profit_2, risk_policy_hash, account authority) used by both TradeIntent builder and PreExecutionValidator; validator recomputes approved contract and rejects any divergence with EXECUTABLE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH

R2_02_testnet_side_effect_persisted_auth.mechanism: PreExecutionAuthorizationV1 receipt durable storage in live_pre_execution_authorizations; TestnetExecutionBackend rejects unpersisted/tampered intents and exposes submit_authorized and reconcile_authorized requiring valid authorization_id; verifies hashes, account authority, and TTL before exchange mutation; in-flight mutation shielded against task cancellation

R2_03_position_lease_ownership_verificat.mechanism: PositionSupervisor verifies lease ownership at each lifecycle transition: case freeze checks rowcount == 1, renews and verifies lease ownership immediately before calling external analysis, and verifies lease on DONE transition; stale workers abort with zero downstream analysis calls

R2_04_live_v1_operational_runtime.mechanism: LiveV1Runtime owns async lifecycles for market stream, TESTNET user data stream, periodic REST reconciliation loop, position outbox recovery drain, and position supervisor polling; integrated into FastAPI lifespan; requires explicit testnet_execution_enabled opt-in; rejects LIVE and AUTONOMOUS configurations; starts unreconciled and recovers state before accepting risk

secret_isolation: no API keys or HMAC secrets in snapshots, intents, events, or logs; errors sanitized
remaining_blockers: None. All R1, R1.1, R1.2, and R2 safety blockers closed. Real-money LIVE execution remains permanently forbidden.
